segments.name: Forged and Cast Engineered Products
segments.description: Produces forged hardened steel rolls, cast rolls and forged engineered products for steel, aluminum, metals, oil and gas, and extrusion industries worldwide.
segments.evidence: The FCEP segment produces forged hardened steel rolls, cast rolls and forged engineered products ("FEP").

segments.name: Air and Liquid Processing
segments.description: Produces custom air handling systems and centrifugal pumps for institutional, pharmaceutical, power generation, marine defense and industrial markets.
segments.evidence: Buffalo Air Handling Division of Air & Liquid Systems Corporation produces large custom-designed air handling systems for institutional (e.g., hospital, university), pharmaceutical and general industrial building markets.

revenueModel.text: Commercial and industrial users pay the company for custom-engineered specialty metal products and equipment delivered directly to them.
revenueModel.evidence: In both segments, products are dependent on engineering, principally custom designed, and are sold to sophisticated commercial and industrial users located throughout the world.

changes.text: In 2025, UES-UK, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, entered administration (Structured Insolvency) with an orderly wind-down and sale of assets.
changes.evidence: As of the Filing Date, UES-UK was in administration and its affairs, business and property were being managed by the Administrators (the "Structured Insolvency").

changes.text: During 2025, the Corporation closed its non-core steel distribution facility in Ohio previously held by AUP, which was merged into Union Electric Steel Corporation in December 2025.
changes.evidence: In addition, during 2025, the Corporation closed its non-core steel distribution facility located in Ohio previously held by Alloys Unlimited and Processing, LLC ("AUP").
